summary: Opponents of expanding deposits tell voters the proposal could damage the system they already use.
realLife: Manufacturers, distributors and retailers made that argument during Oregon’s unsuccessful 1996 expansion initiative.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: ballot text and campaign argument.

turns.what: A supporter asks which existing protections the new text would actually change.
turns.pulledBy: A campaign opponent claims the expansion puts existing refunds at risk.
turns.writesBack: The campaign’s response identifies the disputed clause.

turns.what: After voters reject expansion, an opponent explains which bottles people can still return.
turns.pulledBy: The expansion failed and the earlier law remains in effect.
turns.writesBack: The public explanation lists the categories still covered.
